description: Hosts one child in a native WPF viewport with independently configurable horizontal and vertical scrolling.

horizontalScrollBarVisibility.description: Horizontal scrolling policy. Auto exposes scrolling only when content exceeds the viewport.

verticalScrollBarVisibility.description: Vertical scrolling policy. Auto exposes scrolling only when content exceeds the viewport.

canContentScroll.description: Use logical item scrolling when the hosted content supports IScrollInfo; false keeps pixel-based scrolling for arbitrary layouts.

padding.description: Inner WPF Thickness between the viewport edge and its content.

margin.description: Outer WPF Thickness separating the viewport from adjacent layout.

content.description: Single layout or control subtree hosted by the scrollable viewport.
